card_en: Lahko, can or may, never changes. The verb after it shows the person, as it always does: lahko dobim, can I have; lahko dobimo, can we have. Said as a question, it asks politely.

the two of us.en: Can the two of us have some water?

quick_check.explain_en: Lahko never changes, and the verb after it takes the person, here I: lahko dobim.

helper_de: German changes the helping verb: kann ich, kannst du. Slovenian keeps lahko and changes the main verb: lahko dobim, lahko dobiš.
helper_en: After English can the verb is bare: can I have. After lahko the verb keeps its ending: lahko dobim.
